timeline.2017.title: FOUNDATION
timeline.2017.line1: Established the team under Shandong Tunan, entering the new energy industry and commencing R&D of energy storage products.
timeline.2017.line2: Launched the first-generation products, earning positive feedback from customers.
timeline.2020.title: GROWTH
timeline.2020.line1: Established the Hangzhou R&D center for cutting-edge technology innovation. Founded JKBMS subsidiary, rapidly scaling technical capabilities and team size.
timeline.2020.line2: Successfully expanded into overseas markets. International market share surged rapidly, attracting significant industry attention.
timeline.2023.title: BREAKTHROUGH
timeline.2023.line1: Launched the JKESS brand covering more than 30 countries worldwide. A 5-hectare large-scale modern energy storage production base was completed and put into operation.
timeline.2023.line2: Successfully developed high-voltage commercial & industrial energy storage systems with active balancing technology, helping customers improve returns by 2-5 years.
timeline.2026.title: EXPANSION
timeline.2026.line1: From R&D design and production integration to backend testing and after-sales — JKESS now possesses full-chain capabilities in energy storage system development, manufacturing, and sales services.
timeline.2026.line2: Current production lines reach 2.1 GWh/year capacity, rising as a fast-growing star in the energy storage industry.
